author: Bobby Grayson

metadata.prompt: Introduce a real expression compiler for the pure fragment: if/case/cond as sub-expressions, blocks as nested lets, variable and pattern bindings, pipes desugared, boolean/comparison operators and the decidable Kernel guards. Blockers to close: if/case not at body level 98, block as a sub-expression 26, pipe 38, variable binding 20, binding a pattern 16, operator && 12, Kernel function or guard 33.

title: wf7/control: control flow and expression structure
